test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four parts. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error.

A student becomes / dearer to the teachers / via participating and actively working / towards the glory of the school.

options.text: towards the glory of the school.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. dearer to the teachers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **dearer to the teachers** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The word **dearer** is a comparative form of "dear" and should be used with a reference point (e.g., "dearer than others"). However, in the given sentence, no comparative context is provided.
 
• The correct expression should be **"dear to the teachers."**

Correct sentence: *A student becomes dear to the teachers via participating and actively working towards the glory of the school*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Correct usage of comparatives:** Comparatives like "dearer," "better," or "worse" should only be used when comparing two or more entities.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• Incorrect: This book is better.
 
• Correct: This book is better than the one I read last week.
 
 
 
• In cases where no comparison is intended, the base form of the adjective should be used.
